title: moderation.decision record body
description: A moderator's public, signed decision on a version. The action must reference a known policy clause and a reason.

target.description: Record id of the version or record being decided on.

clause.description: Policy clause id from the moderation policy list.

reason.description: Reason shown to the author and published with the decision.

category.description: New category for a reclassify decision.
